Artist.label: 04 — The Artist
Artist.bio: Shortlord is the owner of Chosenfewrecords. Roots in French Guiana (Guyane), with Caribbean lineage also traced to Martinique and St. Lucia. US-American on his father's side — Chicago. Raised beside the army base in Hessen. He sparked the idea for Black Angel Records (founded by Eric I.Q. Gray) — The Fight dropped there first, then BMG picked it up with massive MTV rotation in Germany 1998/1999. Chosenfewrecords since 2006. Gold record at 18. Now back in full effect.

About.label: 07 — The Label
About.body: Shortlord was the one who brought Class Productions and Phantom Black to Boogiepark in the late 90s, turning it into one of Hamburg's first real hip-hop hotspots. Chosenfewrecords has been independent since 2006 — hip-hop × Caribbean, Rough Trade distribution era, Hamburg Labelförderung recognition, and still building.
